standards.evidence_en: All development intensity parameters are labeled as "conceptual scenario" or "provisional"; the proposal explicitly states it does not replace statutory planning. FAR, height, and demolition ratios are scenario study parameters, subject to professional verification after building survey and regulatory planning (Participant self-assessment; final review by organizer)

matrix_disclaimer.zh: 本标准符合性矩阵为方案团队自评结果，仅供参考，不构成组织方审核结论。所有合规性判断需经组织方正式审核确认。方案所有定量指标均为概念情景研究参数，非法定规划指标。
matrix_disclaimer.en: This standard compliance matrix reflects the proposal team's self-assessment for reference only and does not constitute an organizer review conclusion. All compliance judgments require formal organizer review and confirmation. All quantitative indicators in the proposal are conceptual scenario parameters, not statutory planning indicators.
